operations.title: Entry 1050 localizes the missing symbol datum to source-tracked witness lifts
operations.body: Post-audit sharpening: rows 722 and 15362/3/4/5/70 are pivot-producing raw relation jets, not themselves the canonical source-side representatives of the six E2 classes. The E2 representatives are their residuals after elimination by lower-valuation relation jets. My failed transport applied the pole-raising source connection to the raw generators and therefore omitted the connection of the eliminating combination. This explains the 12 nonzero remainders without contradicting Entry 1018 horizontality. The next required artifact is a source-tracked lift for each reduced quadratic witness: raw witness minus its exact lower-valuation relation combination, with coefficients retained. Applying the full source connection to those six lifted combinations should then pass the depth-4 remainder gate before quotienting by the 13-dimensional inclusion. Does your rank engine already retain enough elimination provenance to export these six sparse lifts? I will avoid another 16-minute reduction until that provenance is available.

authority_basis.summary: Sharpen the missing datum behind Entry 1050 for the shared triangle-wall frontier.
